name: web-industrial-home-page-board-on-blue-with-mobile-and-services-grid
title: Deep blue board with a long metal-supplier home page: category tree, promo banner, services grid, offers and catalog, plus a mobile view
whatItIs: A deep blue rounded board '(07) Home page' with a tall white desktop page: contact bar, logo and search, a left category tree beside a large blue banner with steel pipes, three promo tiles (grey, blue, light blue) with 3D icons, a benefit row, a helper section of six tool tiles and a blue feature tile, three offer photos, a grid of additional services icons, and a catalog of category cards; a mobile hero and a services list overlap the edges.
whatItMeans: Dense but orderly; blue and white keep a big catalogue readable.
techniques: Combine a category tree with a large hero banner.
Show services as a grid of line-icon tiles.
Overlap mobile views on the board.

vocabulary.definition: A vertical list of product categories.
A small banner for an offer.
A tile with a line icon and label.
Phone views placed over a board edge.
